author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Before: a bare S-shaped line plus two strokes; the three workflow boxes were missing, so it read as a number 2. After: outlined start box, middle task box and end box with a rounded connector from the start box down into the end box, matching the reference layout.
omissions: The connector's second switchback is simplified to one rounded elbow: a double switchback beside three 8-tall boxes exceeds the 36-unit SQUARE height at 8 spacing.
